reference.configuration: Argus, US Navy 1943 recognition reference: flush full-length flight deck, no permanent island, hull cut away aft and stern smoke discharge. The rounded forward flight deck and wartime light-AA positions are later alterations; this is not asserted to be the exact 1918 fitting.
